verdict.rationale: Fireflies' Fred assistant is documented as drafting email replies and tracking follow-ups, and separately as producing meeting summaries with action items. That suggests a first-party email-drafting capability next to meeting outputs, but nothing in the evidence ties a drafted email to a specific meeting's content or describes a review-and-send flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that follow-up emails are generated from meeting transcripts or summaries, a review-and-send-in-a-few-clicks workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks

citations.quote: Fred catches you up on email, drafts replies, sorts your inbox, and tracks follow-ups.
Fred records, transcribes, & summarizes meetings with notes, decisions, & action items.
